subject: MAP cadence: request to rebaseline evaluation + contingency options
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP cadence: request to rebaseline evaluation + contingency options

Jordan —

Per our MAP milestones we're scheduled to start the extended eval this week (load/day-1 scenarios + security review). I wanted to surface two risks we saw during the final checklist:

- Acme's internal security questionnaire is still flagged for environment access (item Q4/Q7) — this blocks our provisioning of the dedicated sandbox.
- Procurement indicated their legal review of the SOW will take 10 business days, not the 3 we originally expected.

Given those items, can you confirm whether the internal review will complete this month or whether we should formally rebaseline the close date? Attached is the latest MAP (version 1) with suggested new gating dates and a condensed contingency: a two-week soft extension plus an executive bridge call to unblock priority items.

If you prefer, we can:
- keep the current eval kickoff (best-effort: we’ll hand off a read-only sandbox) OR
- rebaseline close by 14 calendar days and schedule a weekly sync for open risks.

Proposed next step: quick 30-min decision bridge today at 3pm PT to pick the path. If that time doesn't work, suggest alternatives.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
AE, Midmarket | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: 20260714-Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with proposed dates and owners)
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-07-14T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP cadence: request to rebaseline evaluation + contingency options

Connor — thanks for the clear note and for the attachment. Short version: we are slipping.

Context: our security team escalated the questionnaire around privileged access (Q4) and asked for an architecture call before they mark it complete. Legal also discovered a clause in the SOW that needs small redline language for data retention, which has to go through a separate commercial review. Procurement estimates 10 business days.

We can do one of two things:
1) Rebaseline the MAP + close date by 14 days (preferred), or
2) Start the eval with a restricted sandbox (read-only, token-limited) while security finishes review.

If you can offer the read-only option immediately that helps, but our team would still like a formal rebaseline so leadership expectations are aligned. Can we take the two-week rebaseline and schedule the executive bridge on Monday to accelerate the architecture question?

Appreciate the flexibility —
Jordan Miles
Product Ops Manager | Acme Corporation
jordan.miles@acme.com | +1 (206) 777-2233
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP cadence: request to rebaseline evaluation + contingency options

Thanks Jordan — that plan works.

I will:
- Mark the MAP with a 14-calendar-day rebaseline for the close and update milestone owners in the attached spreadsheet.
- Provision a read-only sandbox (token-limited) today so your product team can start smoke tests.
- Book an exec architecture bridge for Monday 10am PT (I’ll include security lead from our side).

Laura — can you confirm the SOC2 artifact bundle and the list of items we should surface in the architecture bridge? I’ve attached the SOW draft that Jordan flagged; Vanessa, can you prep a short redline summary for Legal?

If all good I’ll update the MAP and send a DocuSign request for the revised SOW change (minor retention language).

Connor

Attachment: Acme_SOW_draft.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP cadence: request to rebaseline evaluation + contingency options

Connor / Jordan —

We can provide the SOC2 artifact bundle and a mapping doc that specifically addresses Q4/Q7 (privileged access and KV store handling). I uploaded a short evidence list to share with your security lead and will bring the mapping to Monday's bridge.

Immediate actions:
- I’ll send SOC2_evidence_list.pdf to Jordan now (includes people/process/tooling references).
- We can stand up a read-only sandbox with a 24-hour provisioning SLA after you confirm the IP ranges we should allow.

Jordan — if you confirm IPs we’ll kick the sandbox provisioning. Also Connor, note that providing read-only access while legal finalizes the SOW is a standard trade-off; let’s capture the scope in the updated MAP so procurement sees the limitation.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0146

Attachment: SOC2_evidence_list.pdf
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-07-14T13:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP cadence: request to rebaseline evaluation + contingency options

All — thanks for the quick turnaround.

We will:
- Accept the 14-day rebaseline and update internal leadership. New target close: 2026-07-28.
- Confirm IP ranges for sandbox (10.11.0.0/16 and 52.198.0.0/24) — please proceed with read-only provisioning.
- Schedule the architecture bridge Monday at 10am PT. Security will bring our network architect and the procurement lead will join for the SOW redline discussion.

Please send the updated MAP and the DocuSign link for the small retention clause change when ready. Appreciate the contingency options and the SOC2 artifact list — that helped expedite internal reviews.

Jordan

Procurement: procurement@acme.com included for SOW timing
